offers_products.reason: Manufactures wellheads, SafeDrill wellhead systems and pressure control equipment for oil and gas drilling and completion.

offers_services.reason: Field service technicians, installation crews and equipment rental support wellheads and frac work, alongside manufacturing.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are oil and gas operators and service companies; no households buy wellhead equipment.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells wellheads and pressure control equipment to oil and gas exploration and production operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Wellhead equipment is sold per well drilled and completed, project-driven; repeat business exists but follows drilling activity.

cyclical_demand.reason: Operators cut drilling and completion spending quickly when oil prices fall, reducing wellhead orders.

big_ticket.reason: Wellhead sets are moderate per-well purchases ordered frequently, small relative to total well cost.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufactured wellhead and pressure control equipment, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large exploration and production operators and oilfield service firms.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns manufacturing facilities in several countries and a rental equipment fleet needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Website text is for the Cactus Wellhead brand; the split between product and service revenue is not given.
